tools.name: foresea_forecast
tools.description:
Call this whenever the user asks about probability, likelihood, or whether
        something will happen. Good triggers: "Will X happen?", "What are the chances
        of Y?", "How likely is Z?", "What's the probability that…", "Do you think X
        will…", "Should I bet on…". Returns a calibrate

tools.name: foresea_analyze_market
tools.description:
Call this when the user mentions a specific prediction market by URL, slug,
        or ticker — or asks whether a particular market is over/underpriced. Good
        triggers: "Is this Polymarket fair?", "What's the edge on kalshi:XXXXX?",
        "Should I buy/sell this market?", user pastes a Poly

tools.name: foresea_scan_markets
tools.description:
Call this when the user wants to find mispriced or interesting markets, not
        evaluate a specific one. Good triggers: "What should I bet on?", "Find me
        trading opportunities", "Which markets are mispriced right now?", "What's
        Foresea's best edge today?", "Scan Polymarket for op

tools.name: foresea_batch_quotes
tools.description:
Call this when the user wants current price/volume for several markets
        at once -- a watchlist, a portfolio, "check on these 5 markets" -- instead
        of calling foresea_analyze_market once per market. Each ref is
        "platform:ident", e.g. "kalshi:KXFED-25JUN-H" or
        "polymarke

tools.name: foresea_check_run
tools.description:
Call this after foresea_analyze_market timed out or errored with a
        message naming a client_run_key -- the research it started may still be
        running server-side. Returns {"status": "running", ...} if it's not done
        yet (call again in a bit), or the full report once it is. Do not

tools.name: foresea_track_record
tools.description:
Call this when the user asks how reliable or accurate Foresea is, or wants
        to know whether to trust a forecast. Good triggers: "How good is Foresea?",
        "What's the track record?", "Has it been right before?", "Is it calibrated?",
        "What's the Brier score?". Returns accuracy, Br

tools.name: foresea_edge_board
tools.description:
Call this when the user wants the current top trading opportunities with
        explicit trade directions and historical backing. Good triggers: "What are
        the best bets right now?", "Show me the edge board", "Which model is winning
        the paper-trading competition?", "What's the strong

tools.name: foresea_venue_data
tools.description:
Read public historical markets/candles/trades, batch books/midpoints/spreads,
        fees, holders, open interest, event volume, milestones and weather. Omit
        operation to discover operation names and schemas. No account or write access.

tools.name: foresea_exchange_status
tools.description:
Call this to check Kalshi exchange operational status (trading active flag)
        and operational hours/schedule.

tools.name: foresea_orderbook
tools.description:
Call this to fetch the live bids and asks orderbook depth for a Kalshi market
        ticker (e.g. 'KXFED-25JUN-H') or Polymarket YES-token ID.

tools.name: foresea_market_tags
tools.description:
Call this to sample Polymarket's category vocabulary. Each entry is a
        label and the slug that identifies it.

        This is one page of at most 100 tags, not the full taxonomy: Polymarket
        has tens of thousands, and the endpoint returns a fixed slice that is
        ordered neither

tools.name: foresea_price_history
tools.description:
Call this to retrieve historical price series or OHLC candlesticks for a
        market (e.g. Kalshi ticker or Polymarket token/slug).

tools.name: foresea_live_data
tools.description:
Call this to fetch real-time sports game statistics, play-by-play data, and
        live event feeds from Kalshi. Provide event_ticker for event charts, or
        milestone_id with data_type="game_stats" for play-by-play.

tools.name: foresea_polymarket_meta
tools.description:
Call this to fetch Polymarket metadata: event series listings, community
        discussion comments for a market, or sports league metadata (target: 'series',
        'comments', 'sports', 'teams').

        'series' lists the series and how many events each holds, not the events
        themselves

tools.name: foresea_recent_trades
tools.description: Call this to fetch recent public executed trades / trade tape (prices, sizes, timestamps) on Kalshi or Polymarket.

tools.name: foresea_market_leaderboard
tools.description: Call this to fetch the top profitable prediction market trader leaderboard and rankings from Polymarket.

tools.name: foresea_debate_market
tools.description: Conduct an adversarial multi-agent debate (Bull vs. Bear vs. Chief Risk Judge) to cross-examine evidence and isolate blind spots on a forecasting question.

tools.name: foresea_optimize_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate optimal mathematical Fractional Kelly capital allocations and position sizes across live Grade A/B prediction market opportunities.

tools.name: foresea_feed_latest
tools.description: Fetch the real-time unified Foresea Alpha & Agent Feed, combining live prediction market edge signals, autonomous agent trades & theses, and leaderboard standings.

tools.name: foresea_weather_radar
tools.description:
Scan live temperature and weather prediction markets (Kalshi KXHIGHNY, KXHIGHCHI,
        KXHIGHMIA, KXHIGHAUS, KXHIGHDEN, KXHIGHPHIL, etc.) against neural weather models
        (Google DeepMind WeatherNext 3 / MetNet) and high-resolution multi-model ensembles,
        calibrated with station micro
